views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player.player_id,
  player.debut,
  player.final_game
FROM player
WHERE player.debut IS NOT NULL
  AND player.final_game IS NOT NULL
views.description: Task: Compute the average single career span value in years for all baseball players by, for each player, computing the absolute difference between their debut date and final game date expressed as ye
